findings: A second accepted archive revision of one Taylor numeric article can create a second Project and Signal because project_key includes arcId and the matcher lacks stable article identity or physical site. Keep article identity stable while retaining arcId as observation/version identity.

Article date fallback scans the whole page for MM/DD/YYYY; an unrelated related-item date can become publication_date when Posted on is missing. Scope date extraction to article metadata or fail closed.
